request.title: The Titanic Stewardess Who Wouldn't Sink (Part 1/3)
request.description:
Before Titanic, stewardess Violet Jessop was aboard its sister ship when it crashed into a warship. Would you have taken the Titanic job after that?

Part 1 of 3: The Titanic Stewardess Who Wouldn't Sink

extra_params.video_script: The Titanic wasn't the only disaster this stewardess survived. The movie Titanic shows just one of her three close calls at sea. Her name was Violet Jessop, born in Argentina to Irish parents. In 1911, she was a stewardess on the giant liner Olympic. That September, Olympic collided with a Royal Navy warship called the Hawke. Nobody died, and the damaged liner made it back to port. Then Violet was offered a job on Olympic's brand-new sister ship. It was called Titanic. And as Titanic sank, an officer put something unexpected into her arms. Subscribe so you don't miss Part 2.
